errors.text_span: MMLU and HumanEval, where scores hover around 65% for both models
errors.evidence: This is an over-generalization for the HumanEval benchmark. The scores are not the same for both models; 'LLaMA-3-8B-it' is around 61% and 'Ours' is around 64%. Stating they both hover around 65% is inaccurate.

errors.text_span: The scores generally decrease for subsequent benchmarks
errors.evidence: This statement is an over-generalization. The scores do not follow a consistent decreasing trend; for example, the scores for ARC and MBPP are higher than the preceding benchmark, TruthfulQA.

errors.text_span: TruthfulQA showing scores around 45% for both models
errors.evidence: This is a major error. While the 'LLaMA-3-8B-it' model (blue bar) scores around 45%, the 'Ours' model (orange bar) scores 60%. The description incorrectly states both are around 45% and misses one of the largest performance differences in the chart.

This is an over-generalization for the ARC benchmark. The 'Ours' model (orange bar) scores noticeably higher (approx. 64%) than the 'LLaMA-3-8B-it' model (approx. 59%). Stating both are 'around 60%' obscures this difference.

errors.text_span: LC AlpacaEval-2 showing lower scores around 25% for both models
errors.evidence: This is a major error. While the 'LLaMA-3-8B-it' model (blue bar) scores around 22-23%, the 'Ours' model (orange bar) scores significantly higher at approximately 31%. The description incorrectly states both are around 25%.
